baseline_models.focus_anchor: The paired negations in `ma kunta tatlu ... min kitabin wa-la takhuttuhu bi-yaminika` feed the result clause `idhan la-rtaba al-mubtilun`.
baseline_models.mechanism: Past state, temporal precedence, recitational following, a written object, and the right hand jointly deny both an antecedent textual route and embodied manual production. The apodosis identifies that absent route as what would have supplied active false-makers with a ground for destabilizing the message.

activation_trace.role: Occurrence or presence in time locates the denied practices in the addressee's prior state.
Temporal precedence establishes the before/after boundary on which the provenance argument turns.
Following and succession make recitation a possible dependence on an antecedent sequence.
Ordered letters and the written object supply the hypothetical textual source.
The literal right hand supplies embodied manual agency for the denied inscription.
Agitated suspicion supplies the counterfactual epistemic effect.
Claiming what has no truth makes the doubters active producers of an accusation, not neutral observers.

changed_reading.before: The addressee had not previously read or written a book, so opponents would otherwise have doubted.
changed_reading.after: The verse is a controlled provenance counterfactual: it removes both a prior textual chain and a manual authorship route that would have furnished active falsifiers with a specific basis for suspicion.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The sequence `tatlu min qablihi min kitabin` combines following, priority, and an assembled written object.
baseline_models.mechanism: The T-L-W following image and K-T-B joining image narrow the negation to textual derivation: no earlier assemblage stood before the present message for the addressee to track, recite, and reproduce. This need not be a free-standing assertion about every possible literacy skill.

activation_trace.role: Following in succession recasts recitation as tracking an antecedent sequence.
What precedes supplies the temporal location of the denied source-chain.
Joining part to part makes the book an assembled textual source from which derivation could occur.

changed_reading.before: The clause states a general inability to read a book.
changed_reading.after: The clause more specifically denies an antecedent textual sequence from which the present recitation could have been assembled or derived.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The subject of `la-rtaba` is not an unmarked audience but `al-mubtilun`.
baseline_models.mechanism: R-Y-B supplies destabilized suspicion, while B-T-L supplies both active invalidation and false attribution. Their combination makes doubt a practiced adversarial operation: a prior book or handwritten artifact would become material for nullifying the message.

activation_trace.role: Perturbed suspicion names the state the counterfactual evidence would provoke.
Actively making something void gives the named group an invalidating function.
Producing an untrue claim makes their doubt usable as an accusation of fabrication.

changed_reading.before: Ordinary skeptics would have felt uncertainty.
changed_reading.after: Agents already disposed to invalidate truth would have converted a prior textual history into a false-making charge.

context_deltas.mechanism: The opening assay distinguishes truthful from lying responders. Against that frame, the focus's absent prior reading and handwriting remove a provenance confound: response to the received message can expose orientation rather than rest on evidence of copying.

activation_trace.role: The active false-claimant anchors the assay model back in the focus's named responders.
Assaying a person as metal supplies the diagnostic testing frame.
Disclosure to the knower supplies the test's differentiating outcome.
Truth as soundness and stability supplies one class revealed by the assay.
Contradiction of truth supplies the opposing class revealed by the assay.

structural_cues: 29:2-3 do not leave professed belief untested; their paired outcome classes are truthful and lying responders.
29:48 itself is an if-then evidentiary construction rather than an isolated biographical label.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies an assay and truth/lie outcome classes; I infer that removing an authorship confound makes provenance part of that assay. A live alternative is that 29:48 is only a local rebuttal and does not itself design the broader test.

changed_reading.before: The biographical fact merely rebuts plagiarism.
changed_reading.after: The biographical fact also functions as a clean evidentiary condition under which reception of the message discloses truthful and false-making orientations.

context_deltas.mechanism: Earlier context couples making with falsehood and then restricts the messenger to clear delivery. The focus's book, line, and hand therefore deny a production process that could be alleged as fabrication, while recitation belongs to transmission.

activation_trace.role: Joining parts into an assemblage supplies the human production route being denied.
The literal hand supplies manual agency for that hypothetical production.
Inventing false speech supplies the surah's explicit model of fabricated discourse.
Falsehood turned away from truth supplies the product of that making.
Attributing lying to a message or messenger supplies the recurrent hostile response.
Making meaning clear by speech characterizes the messenger's delivery rather than authorship.

structural_cues: 29:18 restricts the messenger's responsibility to clear conveyance.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies falsehood-making and a messenger limited to clear conveyance; I infer an authorship-versus-delivery contrast with 29:48's hand and recitation. The narrower alternative is simply that the focus denies literacy without classifying discourse roles.

changed_reading.before: The focus denies an educational skill.
changed_reading.after: The focus denies a human manufacturing route for the discourse and separates that route from the messenger's recitational delivery.

context_deltas.mechanism: The same book and recitation roots occur as a present command, a divinely delivered book, and an ongoing recitation. Together with `before it`, they turn the focus into a temporal hinge: no antecedent textual dependence before revelation, followed by recitation after reception. Scriptural continuity is preserved as bestowal and descent, not personal copying.

activation_trace.role: Temporal precedence anchors the change specifically to the period before the present book.
Following and recitational succession name the practice denied in the prior period.
The written Book placed with prophecy in Abraham's descendants supplies scriptural continuity without personal copying.
The command to recite supplies the post-revelation practice that reverses the prior negation.
Divine report and inspiration identify the source of the book now recited.
Sending down and delivering the book supplies reception as the alternative to authorship.
The two book occurrences place the delivered book beside communities already given written scripture.
Delivery from above again fixes the current book's provenance.
Ongoing recitational succession supplies the present circulation of what was not recited before.

structural_cues: 29:45 commands the addressee to recite what was revealed from the Book.
29:46-47 place the delivered Book in relation to earlier recipients of scripture.
29:51 describes the sent-down Book as presently recited to its audience.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies an explicit prior-time boundary, present recitation, revelation, and descent; I infer a biographical transition rather than a timeless incapacity. The alternative is that the temporal wording only dates a permanent inability.

changed_reading.before: The addressee is simply a person who does not read books.
changed_reading.after: The addressee had no pre-revelation source-chain, yet after receiving the Book becomes its commanded reciter within a continuity of delivered scriptures.

context_deltas.mechanism: The immediate sequel relocates the clear signs from a hypothetical authoring hand to the chests of knowers, then presents the delivered Book as sufficient while it is recited. The bodily medium shifts from manual production to internal reception and living voice without denying the Book's textual identity.

activation_trace.role: The literal right hand supplies the bodily site of hypothetical authorship.
Visible identifying marks make the content itself evidentiary signs.
The literal chest supplies an internal bodily site that contrasts with the authoring hand.
Knowledge as disclosure identifies the recipients in whose chests the signs are present.
Standing for the need until sufficiency is reached makes the delivered, recited Book adequate evidence.
Delivery supplies the source-side movement into the receiving community.
The written Book preserves textual identity across the medium shift.
Recitational succession supplies its live voiced circulation to listeners.

structural_cues: 29:49 immediately replaces 29:48's right hand with clear signs in the chests of those given knowledge.
29:51 uses a passive recitation construction: the delivered Book is being recited to them.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies two bodily locations and an ongoing passive recitation; I infer a deliberate medium contrast from authoring hand to receiving chest and voice. The live alternative is that `chests` marks knowledge or memorization without making a broader medium claim.

changed_reading.before: The verse merely says the addressee lacked a writing credential.
changed_reading.after: The verse denies manual provenance while preparing a different evidentiary embodiment: signs borne in knowledgeable chests and a received Book circulating by recitation.

context_deltas.mechanism: The sequel distinguishes a specific possible ground for suspicion from persistent refusal. Even with clear signs and a sufficient recited Book, some knowingly deny, believe in falsehood, fabricate lies, or deny truth. Thus the focus removes an evidentiary pretext; it does not predict that every opponent will become persuaded.

activation_trace.role: Suspicion remains the narrowly counterfactual response tied to prior reading or writing.
The active false-claimant anchors later willful denial in the focus's own subject label.
Denial despite knowledge supplies refusal that survives the removed provenance pretext.
Demanded visible signs supply the opponents' attempt to shift the evidentiary requirement.
The Book's sufficiency answers the shifted demand without promising assent.
Settled assent supplies the paradoxical positive commitment made toward falsehood.
What lacks truth or stability is what later opponents actively believe, sharpening `mubtilun` as an orientation.
Inventing a lie supplies a terminal form of false-making independent of a real copied source.
Attributing lie and denying truth supply two directed acts rather than passive uncertainty.
Truth fixed to reality supplies the object that can still be denied when it arrives.

structural_cues: 29:47 and 29:49 restrict rejection of the signs to culpable classes.
29:50 requests additional signs, while 29:51 answers that the recited Book is sufficient.
29:52 and 29:67 describe positive belief in falsehood, and 29:68 pairs invented lying with denial of arriving truth.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies sufficiency, knowledgeable denial, belief in falsehood, and invented lying; I infer that 29:48 removes one plausible allegation rather than every psychological cause of rejection. The alternative is to hear `would have doubted` as a broad claim that no doubt remains.

changed_reading.before: Absence of prior literacy should make doubt impossible.
changed_reading.after: Absence of prior textual production forecloses one potentially credible authorship charge, while active nullifiers can still relocate their demand or choose falsehood over sufficient signs.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it reverses 29:35's surviving material trace: the focus has no handwritten trace, yet that very absence becomes provenance evidence. It remains anchored in `wa-la takhuttuhu bi-yaminika` and the packet's trace/sign branches, but downstream prose should mark it as an abductive analogy, not the lexical meaning of the clause.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The negated act of tracing the Book with the right hand leaves an evidentiary absence.

activation_trace.role: The written object supplies the kind of artifact for which a manual trace could be sought.
The literal hand supplies the absent producer-trace.
Leaving an effect behind supplies the material-trace pattern that the focus reverses.
A manifest mark turns a residual trace into evidence.
Manifest disclosure supplies the evidentiary clarity of the trace.
Reason restraining ignorance supplies the observer who can infer from a trace or its absence.

changed_reading.before: There is simply no handwritten artifact from the addressee.
changed_reading.after: Like a residual sign, the missing producer-trace can itself function as a positive mark of non-derivative provenance for a reasoning observer.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: The oath and power branches of Y-M-N are more distant than the literal right hand, so this should not replace the manual-writing reading. It remains anchored in `bi-yaminika` and becomes worth carrying because 29:52 supplies a sufficient knowledgeable witness; render it as a possible juridical resonance, not a translation of `yamin` as oath.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The denied inscription is specifically attached to `your right hand`, whose inventory also carries oath and authoritative power.

activation_trace.role: The oath branch gives the right hand a possible attesting resonance beyond the literal limb.
Right-side force and authority supply the possibility of an authorial warrant or signature.
Sufficiency makes the ensuing witness adequate without a personal written attestation.
Testimony grounded in knowledge supplies the alternative attesting authority.
Knowledge as disclosure grounds the divine witness that replaces any alleged authorial warrant.

changed_reading.before: The right hand only identifies the limb that did not write.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, the absent authorial hand also withholds a personal signature, oath, or warrant, while the next evidentiary movement rests on God's sufficient knowledgeable witness.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: The sound-following-sound branch is a branch image rather than the ordinary lexical rendering of `tatlu`, so it should remain a material-auditory resonance. It is securely anchored in the repeated T-L-W occurrence at 29:51 and clarifies the contrast with handwriting; downstream prose should qualify it as a medium image.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus denies earlier `tatlu` from a Book while separately denying manual inscription.

activation_trace.role: One sound following another supplies an auditory sequence for the denied prior recitation.
Joined parts supply the contrasting assembled textual object.
The Book now being recited supplies the live chain in which voice follows voice.
The written Book remains the identity carried through that auditory chain.

changed_reading.before: Recitation and writing are merely two absent literacy skills.
changed_reading.after: The verse can also stage two material chains: no earlier sound-sequence drawn from a book and no hand-produced line, followed later by a received Book living as sound follows sound.

strongest_changes: The repeated T-L-W and K-T-B occurrences make 29:48 a temporal hinge from no pre-revelation source-chain to commanded, received, ongoing recitation.
29:49-51 shift evidentiary embodiment from a hypothetical authoring hand to clear signs in knowledgeable chests and a sufficient Book circulating by voice.
Later knowledgeable denial, belief in falsehood, and invented lying show that the counterfactual removes one authorship pretext rather than every form of refusal.
summary.what_was_special: Whole-surah sequencing reversed the valence of the focus's negations: the same book and recitation branches denied as prior provenance reappear as present revelation, sufficient evidence, and embodied transmission, while `mubtilun` develops from possible doubters into agents who affirm falsehood and deny truth.
remaining_uncertainties: Whether the opening test frame makes provenance a designed assay or only supplies thematic resonance.
How far the oath and authority branches of `yamin` should color the literal right-hand construction.
Whether the absence of a handwritten trace is strong enough to render as a positive sign outside exploratory commentary.
